sfwmark.name: SFWMark
sfwmark.payload: keyed Fourier-domain latent watermark; repo CLI selects wm_type rather than arbitrary text payload
sfwmark.notes: Generation-time latent-noise watermarking. Detection uses DDIM inversion and Fourier-domain analysis.

gaussian-shannon.name: Gaussian Shannon
gaussian-shannon.payload: 256-bit message encoded with Gaussian/LDPC communication coding
gaussian-shannon.notes: Repo code is function-oriented rather than a polished CLI. The adapter runner calls its coding, latent insertion, inversion, and decoding functions.

lawa.name: LaWa

default_config.default_prompt: A white plate of food on a dining table

lawa.payload: exactly 48 binary bits for the provided pretrained decoder
lawa.environment: conda env create -f environment.yml; tested with python 3.8.17, pytorch 2.0.1, cuda 11.3
lawa.notes: In-generation image watermarking through Stable Diffusion v1.4 and a modified decoder. Public script does not expose arbitrary uploaded-image embedding.

gaussian-shading.name: Gaussian Shading
gaussian-shading.payload: repository-generated 256-bit watermark diffused across a 1 x 4 x 64 x 64 Gaussian latent
gaussian-shading.environment: separate Python environment with the upstream Gaussian-Shading checkout and CUDA
gaussian-shading.notes: Generation uses distribution-preserving truncated-Gaussian sampling. Verification uses empty-prompt DDIM inversion, the saved key, bit accuracy, and the repository's detection and traceability thresholds.

prc-watermark.name: PRC-Watermark
prc-watermark.payload: keyed PRC codeword with binary watermark-present or watermark-absent output
prc-watermark.environment: separate Python environment with the upstream PRC-Watermark checkout and CUDA
prc-watermark.notes: The released script generates a random PRC payload and reports Detect, Decode-valid, and their OR-combined binary decision. It does not expose candidate-bank identification.
